in_sanskrit.name: Joishansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Justice
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Joishansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Joishansh is a name derived from Sanskrit language which means 'God of Justice'. This name is inspired by Lord Ishan, who is a form of Lord Vishnu, and is known for maintaining the balance of justice in the universe.
